```{=html}
  </div>

  <footer class="cb-bottom"><div><strong>Interpretation:</strong> Simulated inventory states and service failures are model outputs, not observed historical failures. Historical trip records inform the scenario demand. The saved per-station initial allocation is applied once at midnight as an assumption. LP uses the full day's known scenario demand; it is not live forecasting. A ZIP-filtered transfer is counted once when either endpoint lies within the selection.</div><div>Capital Bikeshare · January 2025</div></footer>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  function start() {
    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    const node = $('cb-dashboard-json');
    if (!node) { $('cb-map').textContent = 'Dashboard data was not embedded during Quarto rendering.'; return; }
    let D;
    try { D = JSON.parse(node.textContent); } catch (error) { $('cb-map').textContent = 'Could not read embedded dashboard data.'; console.error(error); return; }
    const POLICIES = [
      {key:'baseline', name:'No rebalancing', short:'Baseline', color:'#97a5b3'},
      {key:'heuristic', name:'Reactive heuristic', short:'Heuristic', color:'#dfa344'},
      {key:'lp', name:'LP optimization', short:'LP', color:'#357cac'}
    ];
    const fmt = value => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits:6}).format(Number(value) || 0);
    const dec = (value, digits=1) => Number.isFinite(Number(value)) ? Number(value).toFixed(digits) : '—';
    const safe = value => String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    const num = value => Number(value) || 0;
    const sum = (items, field) => items.reduce((a,r) => a + num(r[field]), 0);
    const zips = [...new Set((D.stations || []).map(r => String(r.ZIP_CODE)))].sort();
    const times = D.times || [];
    const defaultTime = times.find(t => t.time_key.slice(11,13) === '16')?.time_key || times[0]?.time_key || 'all';
    const S = {policy:'lp', time:defaultTime, zips:new Set(zips), snapshot:'inventory_after_rebalancing', metric:'fill', showZips:true, showTransfers:true};
    const stationMap = new Map((D.stations || []).map(r => [String(r.short_name),r]));
    const C = Object.fromEntries(POLICIES.map(p => [p.key,p.color]));
    let map = null, zipLayer = null, stationsLayer = null, transferLayer = null, allBounds = null;
    function zipRows() { return (D.simulations || []).filter(r => S.zips.has(String(r.ZIP_CODE)) && (S.time === 'all' || r.time_key === S.time)); }
    function policyRows(key=S.policy) { return zipRows().filter(r => r.policy_key === key); }
    function routeRows(key=S.policy, time=S.time) {
      return (D.transfers || []).filter(r => r.policy_key === key && (time === 'all' || r.time_key === time) && (S.zips.has(String(r.from_zip)) || S.zips.has(String(r.to_zip))));
    }
    function aggregateStation(rows) {
      const items = new Map();
      for (const r of rows) {
        const k = String(r.short_name);
        if (!items.has(k)) items.set(k,{...r, intervals:0, station_event_failures:0, requested_station_events:0, served_station_events:0, unmet_departures:0, blocked_arrivals:0, start_inventory:0, inventory_after_rebalancing:0, end_inventory:0});
        const a = items.get(k);
        a.intervals++;
        for (const field of ['station_event_failures','requested_station_events','served_station_events','unmet_departures','blocked_arrivals','start_inventory','inventory_after_rebalancing','end_inventory']) a[field] += num(r[field]);
      }
      for (const a of items.values()) {
        for (const field of ['start_inventory','inventory_after_rebalancing','end_inventory']) a[field] /= a.intervals;
      }
      return [...items.values()];
    }
    function timeDescription() { return S.time === 'all' ? `All ${times.length} modeled intervals` : (times.find(t => t.time_key === S.time)?.time_label || S.time); }
    function countUpdate() {
      $('cb-n-stations').textContent=fmt((D.stations||[]).length);
      $('cb-n-zips').textContent=fmt(zips.length);
      $('cb-n-times').textContent=fmt(times.length);
      $('cb-n-policies').textContent=fmt(POLICIES.length);
      $('cb-header-sub').textContent=`${times[0]?.time_key.slice(0,10) || ''} · ${times.length} modeled hourly intervals`;
    }
    function drawZipPicker() {
      const q = $('cb-zip-search').value.trim();
      $('cb-zip-count').textContent=`${S.zips.size} of ${zips.length} ZIPs selected`;
      $('cb-zip-items').innerHTML=zips.filter(z => !q || z.includes(q)).map(z => `<label class="cb-zip-item"><input type="checkbox" data-zip="${safe(z)}" ${S.zips.has(z) ? 'checked' : ''}>${safe(z)}</label>`).join('') || '<div class="cb-empty">No matching ZIPs</div>';
      $('cb-zip-items').querySelectorAll('[data-zip]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', () => {const z=input.dataset.zip;input.checked?S.zips.add(z):S.zips.delete(z);drawZipPicker();updateAll();}));
    }
    function fillClass(row) {
      const capacity = num(row.capacity);
      const ratio = capacity > 0 ? num(row[S.snapshot])/capacity : null;
      if (ratio == null) return '#8394a5';
      if (ratio < .15) return '#cb4958';
      if (ratio < .35) return '#ecad43';
      if (ratio < .80) return '#1c958e';
      if (ratio < .95) return '#377bab';
      return '#7d57a4';
    }
    // Zero-event stations remain easy to locate, using a distinct color for
    // each policy. Warm colors are reserved for actual service failures.
    function zeroEventColor() {
      return {lp:'#eab308', heuristic:'#0f766e', baseline:'#64748b'}[S.policy];
    }
    function metricField() {
      return {failures:'station_event_failures', unmet:'unmet_departures', blocked:'blocked_arrivals'}[S.metric] || 'station_event_failures';
    }
    function metricValue(row) { return num(row[metricField()]); }
    function stationColor(row) {
      if (S.metric === 'fill') return fillClass(row);
      const v = metricValue(row);
      if (v <= 0) return zeroEventColor(); // Zero events, shown in policy color
      if (v < 2) return '#f97316';          // Exactly 1 event
      if (v < 4) return '#ef4444';          // 2–3 events
      return '#b91c1c';                    // 4+ events
    }
    function drawLegend() {
      const policyName = {lp:'LP', heuristic:'Heuristic', baseline:'Baseline'}[S.policy];
      const values = S.metric === 'fill'
        ? [['#cb4958','<15%'],['#ecad43','15–35%'],['#1c958e','35–80%'],['#377bab','80–95%'],['#7d57a4','≥95%']]
        : [[zeroEventColor(),`0 events (${policyName})`],['#f97316','1 event'],['#ef4444','2–3'],['#b91c1c','4+']];
      $('cb-map-legend').innerHTML=values.map(([color,label])=>`<span class="cb-legend-item"><i style="background:${color}"></i>${label}</span>`).join('');
    }
    function popupHtml(r) {
      return `<b>${safe(r.station_name || stationMap.get(String(r.short_name))?.name || r.short_name)}</b><br>ZIP ${safe(r.ZIP_CODE)} · Capacity ${fmt(r.capacity)}<br>Snapshot inventory: ${fmt(r[S.snapshot])} / ${fmt(r.capacity)}${S.time==='all'?' (mean)':''}<br>Requested events: ${fmt(r.requested_station_events)}<br>Unmet departures: ${fmt(r.unmet_departures)}<br>Blocked arrivals: ${fmt(r.blocked_arrivals)}<br>Total service failures: ${fmt(r.station_event_failures)}`;
    }
    function initMap() {
      if (typeof window.L === 'undefined') { $('cb-map').innerHTML='<div class="cb-map-fallback">Leaflet did not initialize. Check the local assets/leaflet files and the AMD-loading guard. Other dashboard controls and metrics remain available.</div>';return; }
      $('cb-map').textContent='';
      map=L.map('cb-map', {
        preferCanvas: true,
        zoomControl: false,
        scrollWheelZoom: true,
        maxZoom: 18,
        maxBoundsViscosity: 1.0,
        inertia: false,
        bounceAtZoomLimits: false,
        worldCopyJump: false
      }).setView([38.903,-77.032],12);
      L.control.zoom({position:'bottomright'}).addTo(map);
      L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {attribution:'&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap contributors</a>',maxZoom:18, noWrap:true}).addTo(map);
      zipLayer=L.geoJSON(D.zip_geo || {type:'FeatureCollection',features:[]},{
        style:f=>({color:S.zips.has(String(f.properties.ZIP_CODE))?'#3e719b':'#93a4b4',weight:1.25,fillColor:'#93bad7',fillOpacity:S.zips.has(String(f.properties.ZIP_CODE))?.09:.015,opacity:.85}),
        onEachFeature:(f,layer)=>{const z=String(f.properties.ZIP_CODE);layer.bindTooltip(`ZIP ${z}`,{sticky:true});layer.on('click',()=>{S.zips.has(z)?S.zips.delete(z):S.zips.add(z);drawZipPicker();updateAll();});}
      });
      transferLayer=L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
      stationsLayer=L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
      if(S.showZips) zipLayer.addTo(map);
      const p=(D.stations || []).filter(s=>Number.isFinite(Number(s.lat)) && Number.isFinite(Number(s.lon))).map(s=>[num(s.lat),num(s.lon)]);
      if (p.length) {
        allBounds = L.latLngBounds(p);
        // Use ALL modeled stations, not the current ZIP/time selection.
        const overviewBounds = allBounds.pad(0.08);

        function constrainMapView(resetToOverview = false) {
          const size = map.getSize();
          if (size.x <= 0 || size.y <= 0) return;
          const wasAtOverview = resetToOverview ||
            map.getZoom() <= map.getMinZoom() + 1e-8;

          // Calculate the overview zoom without reusing a previous minZoom.
          // This allows the limits to adapt when the map panel is resized.
          const nw = map.project(overviewBounds.getNorthWest(), 0);
          const se = map.project(overviewBounds.getSouthEast(), 0);
          const span = se.subtract(nw);
          const scale = Math.min(
            size.x / Math.max(span.x, 1e-9),
            size.y / Math.max(span.y, 1e-9)
          );
          const overviewZoom = Math.max(0, Math.min(
            map.getMaxZoom(), Math.floor(map.getScaleZoom(scale, 0))
          ));
          const overviewCenter = map.unproject(nw.add(se).divideBy(2), 0);

          // The allowed region is the initial full-network viewport, with
          // a two-pixel margin to avoid rounding jitter at its edges.
          // It is NOT recomputed when users pan, zoom, or filter the data.
          const pixelCenter = map.project(overviewCenter, overviewZoom);
          const halfView = size.divideBy(2).add(L.point(2, 2));
          const allowedBounds = L.latLngBounds(
            map.unproject(pixelCenter.subtract(halfView), overviewZoom),
            map.unproject(pixelCenter.add(halfView), overviewZoom)
          );

          map.setMinZoom(overviewZoom);
          map.setMaxBounds(allowedBounds);
          if (wasAtOverview) {
            map.setView(overviewCenter, overviewZoom, {animate: false});
          }
          map.panInsideBounds(allowedBounds, {animate: false});
        }

        constrainMapView(true);
        map.on('resize', () => constrainMapView());

        // Also handle container resizing caused by the responsive layout.
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
          let resizeFrame = null;
          const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            if (resizeFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);
            resizeFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              resizeFrame = null;
              map.invalidateSize({animate: false, pan: false});
            });
          });
          observer.observe($('cb-map'));
          map.on('unload', () => {
            observer.disconnect();
            if (resizeFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);
          });
        }
      }
      setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize({animate: false, pan: false}), 100);
    }
    function zoomSelection() {
      if(!map)return;
      const selected=(D.stations||[]).filter(s=>S.zips.has(String(s.ZIP_CODE))&&Number.isFinite(Number(s.lat))&&Number.isFinite(Number(s.lon))).map(s=>[num(s.lat),num(s.lon)]);
      if(selected.length)map.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(selected).pad(.14),{maxZoom:14});
      else if(allBounds)map.fitBounds(allBounds.pad(.08));
    }
    function drawMap() {
      const rows=aggregateStation(policyRows());
      const policyName = POLICIES.find(p=>p.key===S.policy)?.name;
      const eventLabels = {failures:'Service failures',unmet:'Unmet departures',blocked:'Blocked arrivals'};
      const eventCount = S.metric === 'fill' ? 0 : sum(rows,metricField());
      const affectedStations = S.metric === 'fill' ? 0 : rows.filter(r=>metricValue(r)>0).length;
      const metricSummary = S.metric === 'fill'
        ? 'Inventory fill ratio'
        : `${eventLabels[S.metric]}: ${fmt(eventCount)} events at ${fmt(affectedStations)} stations`;
      $('cb-map-description').textContent=`${policyName} · ${timeDescription()} · ${rows.length} stations · ${metricSummary}`;
      drawLegend();
      if(!map)return;
      if(S.showZips && !map.hasLayer(zipLayer))map.addLayer(zipLayer);
      if(!S.showZips && map.hasLayer(zipLayer))map.removeLayer(zipLayer);
      zipLayer.eachLayer(layer=>layer.setStyle({color:S.zips.has(String(layer.feature.properties.ZIP_CODE))?'#3e719b':'#93a4b4',fillOpacity:S.zips.has(String(layer.feature.properties.ZIP_CODE))?.09:.015}));
      stationsLayer.clearLayers();transferLayer.clearLayers();
      if (S.showTransfers) for(const tr of routeRows()) {
        const a=[Number(tr.from_lat),Number(tr.from_lon)],b=[Number(tr.to_lat),Number(tr.to_lon)];
        if(![...a,...b].every(Number.isFinite))continue;
        L.polyline([a,b],{color:S.policy==='lp'?'#3869b5':'#d78b31',weight:Math.min(6,1.7+num(tr.bikes)*.55),opacity:.64,dashArray:S.policy==='heuristic'?'6 5':null})
          .bindPopup(`<b>${safe(tr.from_station)} → ${safe(tr.to_station)}</b><br>${fmt(tr.bikes)} bikes · ${dec(tr.distance_km,2)} km<br>${safe(tr.time_label||'')}`)
          .addTo(transferLayer);
      }
      // Draw high-risk stations LAST, so non-zero results are not obscured
      // by many other markers in dense parts of Washington, DC.
      const ordered = S.metric === 'fill'
        ? rows : [...rows].sort((a,b)=>metricValue(a)-metricValue(b));
      for(const row of ordered) {
        const lat=Number(row.lat),lon=Number(row.lon);
        if(!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lon))continue;
        const eventCount = metricValue(row);
        const active = eventCount > 0;
        const markerStyle = S.metric === 'fill'
          ? {radius:5.1,weight:1.2,color:'#fff',opacity:.96,fillColor:stationColor(row),fillOpacity:.92}
          : {radius:active?6.3+Math.min(3.5,Math.sqrt(eventCount)*1.1):5.5,
             weight:active?1.5:1.3,
             color:active?'#fff':(S.policy==='lp'?'#854d0e':'#fff'),
             opacity:1,fillColor:stationColor(row),fillOpacity:active?1:.96};
        L.circleMarker([lat,lon],markerStyle)
          .bindPopup(popupHtml(row),{maxWidth:270})
          .addTo(stationsLayer);
      }
    }
    function drawKpis() {
      const rows=policyRows(), routes=routeRows(), unique=new Set(rows.map(r=>String(r.short_name)));
      const requested=sum(rows,'requested_station_events'),served=sum(rows,'served_station_events');
      const fieldMap={'cb-k-stations':fmt(unique.size),'cb-k-demand':fmt(requested),'cb-k-success':requested?`${dec(100*served/requested,1)}%`:'—','cb-k-fail':fmt(sum(rows,'station_event_failures')),'cb-k-unmet':fmt(sum(rows,'unmet_departures')),'cb-k-blocked':fmt(sum(rows,'blocked_arrivals')),'cb-k-bikes':fmt(sum(routes,'bikes')),'cb-k-bike-km':dec(sum(routes,'bike_km'),1)};
      for(const [id,v] of Object.entries(fieldMap)) $(id).textContent=v;
    }
    function drawPolicyChart() {
      const groups=POLICIES.map(p=>{const rows=policyRows(p.key);return {...p,unmet:sum(rows,'unmet_departures'),blocked:sum(rows,'blocked_arrivals'),asked:sum(rows,'requested_station_events'),served:sum(rows,'served_station_events')};});
      const max=Math.max(1,...groups.map(p=>p.unmet+p.blocked));
      $('cb-policy-chart').innerHTML=groups.map(p=>`<div class="cb-policy-row" title="${safe(p.name)} — ${fmt(p.unmet+p.blocked)} service failures"><div class="cb-policy-name" style="${p.key===S.policy?'color:#204d78':''}">${safe(p.name)}${p.key===S.policy?' ◂':''}</div><div class="cb-policy-bar-track"><div style="width:${(p.unmet/max*100).toFixed(2)}%;background:#e49b49"></div><div style="width:${(p.blocked/max*100).toFixed(2)}%;background:#c95257"></div></div><div class="cb-policy-num">${fmt(p.unmet+p.blocked)}</div></div>`).join('');
      $('cb-policy-foot').textContent=groups.map(p=>`${p.short}: ${p.asked?dec(p.served/p.asked*100,1)+'%':'—'} success`).join('   ·   ');
    }
    function drawTimeTrend() {
      const max=Math.max(1,...times.flatMap(t=>POLICIES.map(p=>sum((D.simulations||[]).filter(r=>r.time_key===t.time_key && r.policy_key===p.key && S.zips.has(String(r.ZIP_CODE))),'station_event_failures'))));
      $('cb-time-chart').innerHTML=`<div class="cb-trend">${times.map(t=>`<div class="cb-time-group ${S.time===t.time_key?'selected':''}" data-time="${safe(t.time_key)}" title="Select ${safe(t.time_label)}">${POLICIES.map(p=>{const v=sum((D.simulations||[]).filter(r=>r.time_key===t.time_key && r.policy_key===p.key && S.zips.has(String(r.ZIP_CODE))),'station_event_failures');return `<div class="cb-time-bar" style="height:${Math.max(v?2:0,v/max*145).toFixed(1)}px;background:${p.color}" title="${safe(p.name)}: ${fmt(v)} failures"></div>`}).join('')}<span class="cb-time-label">${safe(t.time_label)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
      $('cb-time-chart').querySelectorAll('[data-time]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>{S.time=el.dataset.time;$('cb-time-choice').value=S.time;updateAll();}));
    }
    function drawStationTable() {
      const rows=aggregateStation(policyRows()).sort((a,b)=>num(b.station_event_failures)-num(a.station_event_failures)||num(b.requested_station_events)-num(a.requested_station_events)).slice(0,9);
      if(!rows.length){$('cb-station-table').innerHTML='<div class="cb-empty">Select at least one ZIP code to see station results.</div>';return;}
      $('cb-station-table').innerHTML=`<table class="cb-table"><thead><tr><th>Station</th><th>ZIP</th><th class="num">Events</th><th class="num">Fails</th><th class="num">Fill</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r=>`<tr><td class="station-name">${safe(r.station_name||r.short_name)}</td><td>${safe(r.ZIP_CODE)}</td><td class="num">${fmt(r.requested_station_events)}</td><td class="num">${fmt(r.station_event_failures)}</td><td class="num">${num(r.capacity)?dec(100*num(r[S.snapshot])/num(r.capacity),0)+'%':'—'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
    }
    function drawTransferTable() {
      const rows=routeRows().sort((a,b)=>num(b.bikes)-num(a.bikes)||num(b.bike_km)-num(a.bike_km)).slice(0,9);
      if(!rows.length){$('cb-transfer-table').innerHTML='<div class="cb-empty">No modeled relocation corridors for the current selection.</div>';return;}
      $('cb-transfer-table').innerHTML=`<table class="cb-table"><thead><tr><th>From → To</th><th class="num">Bikes</th><th class="num">km</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r=>`<tr><td class="station-name">${safe(r.from_station||r.from_short_name)}<br><span class="cb-muted">→ ${safe(r.to_station||r.to_short_name)}</span></td><td class="num">${fmt(r.bikes)}</td><td class="num">${dec(r.distance_km,2)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
    }
    function readableColumn(key) {return String(key).replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/\b[a-z]/g,s=>s.toUpperCase());}
    function dataColumns() {return D.budget_columns || Object.keys((D.budget||[])[0]||{});}
    function bestBudgetColumns() {
      const keys=dataColumns();const rows=D.budget||[];
      const nums=keys.filter(k=>rows.filter(r=>r[k]!=null && Number.isFinite(Number(r[k]))).length>=Math.max(2,rows.length/2));
      const weigh=(k,rewards)=>rewards.reduce((score,[regex,v])=>score+(regex.test(k)?v:0),0);
      const budget=nums.filter(k=>/budget|^B$|limit/i.test(k)).sort((a,b)=>weigh(b,[[/budget/i,20],[/bike/i,5],[/limit/i,4],[/^B$/i,8]])-weigh(a,[[/budget/i,20],[/bike/i,5],[/limit/i,4],[/^B$/i,8]]))[0];
      const metric=nums.filter(k=>k!==budget && /fail|unmet|blocked|objective|cost|penalty|loss/i.test(k)).sort((a,b)=>weigh(b,[[/total.*fail|fail.*total/i,40],[/service.*fail|fail.*service/i,35],[/unmet/i,23],[/blocked/i,20],[/objective/i,17],[/cost|penalty|loss/i,15]])-weigh(a,[[/total.*fail|fail.*total/i,40],[/service.*fail|fail.*service/i,35],[/unmet/i,23],[/blocked/i,20],[/objective/i,17],[/cost|penalty|loss/i,15]]))[0];
      return {budget,metric};
    }
    function drawBudget() {
      const records=D.budget||[],keys=dataColumns();
      if(!records.length){$('cb-budget-chart').innerHTML='<div class="cb-empty">No saved budget scenarios.</div>';$('cb-budget-table').textContent='';return;}
      const {budget,metric}=bestBudgetColumns();
      if(!budget||!metric){$('cb-budget-chart').innerHTML='<div class="cb-empty">Budget metric columns could not be identified; raw scenarios are shown at right.</div>';} else {
        const values=records.filter(r=>Number.isFinite(Number(r[budget]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[metric]))).map(r=>({x:Number(r[budget]),y:Number(r[metric])})).sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x);
        if(values.length>1){
          const xs=values.map(p=>p.x),ys=values.map(p=>p.y),xmin=Math.min(...xs),xmax=Math.max(...xs),ymin=Math.min(...ys),ymax=Math.max(...ys);
          const w=720,h=232,left=57,right=18,top=17,bottom=43,xx=x=>left+(x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin||1)*(w-left-right),yy=y=>top+(ymax-y)/(ymax-ymin||1)*(h-top-bottom);
          const poly=values.map(p=>`${xx(p.x).toFixed(2)},${yy(p.y).toFixed(2)}`).join(' ');
          const axis=Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>{const f=i/3,y=top+f*(h-top-bottom);return `<line x1="${left}" y1="${y}" x2="${w-right}" y2="${y}"></line><text x="${left-11}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end">${dec(ymax-f*(ymax-ymin),1)}</text>`}).join('');
          $('cb-budget-chart').innerHTML=`<svg class="cb-budget-plot" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" role="img" aria-label="Budget sensitivity chart: ${safe(budget)} versus ${safe(metric)}">${axis}<polyline points="${poly}"></polyline>${values.map(p=>`<circle cx="${xx(p.x).toFixed(2)}" cy="${yy(p.y).toFixed(2)}" r="5"><title>${safe(readableColumn(budget))}: ${p.x} · ${safe(readableColumn(metric))}: ${p.y}</title></circle>`).join('')}<text x="${left}" y="${h-18}" text-anchor="middle">${dec(xmin,1)}</text><text x="${w-right}" y="${h-18}" text-anchor="middle">${dec(xmax,1)}</text><text x="${w/2}" y="${h-3}" text-anchor="middle">${safe(readableColumn(budget))}</text></svg>`;
        } else $('cb-budget-chart').innerHTML='<div class="cb-empty">Insufficient numeric values to plot.</div>';
      }
      const show=[budget,metric,...keys.filter(k=>k!==budget&&k!==metric)].filter(Boolean).slice(0,5);
      $('cb-budget-table').innerHTML=`<table class="cb-table"><thead><tr>${show.map(k=>`<th>${safe(readableColumn(k))}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${records.map(r=>`<tr>${show.map(k=>`<td>${safe(r[k] == null ? '—' : r[k])}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
      $('cb-budget-info').textContent=budget&&metric?`X: ${readableColumn(budget)} · Y: ${readableColumn(metric)} · ${records.length} saved scenarios. These budget points do not change the station map.`:`${records.length} saved scenarios, with original field names shown at right.`;
    }
    function exportCSV() {
      const fields=['policy_label','time_label','ZIP_CODE','short_name','station_name','capacity','start_inventory','inventory_after_rebalancing','end_inventory','requested_station_events','served_station_events','unmet_departures','blocked_arrivals','station_event_failures'];
      const vals=policyRows();
      const quoted=v=>`"${String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')}"`;
      const csv=[fields.join(','),...vals.map(r=>fields.map(f=>quoted(r[f])).join(','))].join('\r\n');
      const blob=new Blob(['\ufeff',csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url;a.download=`capital_bikeshare_${S.policy}_${S.time==='all'?'all_intervals':'interval'}.csv`;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1500);
    }
    function updateAll() {drawMap();drawKpis();drawPolicyChart();drawTimeTrend();drawStationTable();drawTransferTable();}
    function wireControls() {
      $('cb-time-choice').innerHTML=`<option value="all">All modeled intervals</option>`+times.map(t=>`<option value="${safe(t.time_key)}">${safe(t.time_label)}</option>`).join('');
      $('cb-time-choice').value=S.time;
      document.querySelectorAll('input[name="cb-policy"]').forEach(input=>{input.checked=input.value===S.policy;input.addEventListener('change',()=>{if(input.checked){S.policy=input.value;updateAll();}});});
      $('cb-time-choice').addEventListener('change',e=>{S.time=e.target.value;updateAll();});
      $('cb-state-choice').addEventListener('change',e=>{S.snapshot=e.target.value;updateAll();});
      $('cb-map-metric').addEventListener('change',e=>{S.metric=e.target.value;updateAll();});
      $('cb-show-zips').addEventListener('change',e=>{S.showZips=e.target.checked;drawMap();});
      $('cb-show-transfers').addEventListener('change',e=>{S.showTransfers=e.target.checked;drawMap();});
      $('cb-zip-search').addEventListener('input',drawZipPicker);
      $('cb-zip-all').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.zips=new Set(zips);drawZipPicker();updateAll();});
      $('cb-zip-none').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.zips.clear();drawZipPicker();updateAll();});
      $('cb-zoom').addEventListener('click',zoomSelection);
      $('cb-export').addEventListener('click',exportCSV);
      $('cb-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.policy='lp';S.time=defaultTime;S.zips=new Set(zips);S.snapshot='inventory_after_rebalancing';S.metric='fill';S.showZips=true;S.showTransfers=true;$('cb-zip-search').value='';$('cb-time-choice').value=S.time;$('cb-state-choice').value=S.snapshot;$('cb-map-metric').value=S.metric;$('cb-show-zips').checked=true;$('cb-show-transfers').checked=true;document.querySelectorAll('input[name="cb-policy"]').forEach(i=>i.checked=i.value===S.policy);drawZipPicker();updateAll();zoomSelection();});
    }
        // Guided tour and route inspection: presentation only.
    const tourApp = $('cb-app');
    let focusedRoute = null;
    let focusRenderer = null;
    let savedTourView = null;

    function validTourTransfer(tr) {
      return num(tr.bikes) > 0 &&
        [tr.from_lat, tr.from_lon, tr.to_lat, tr.to_lon].every(
          v => v !== null && v !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(v))
        );
    }

    function clearTourRoute() {
      if (focusedRoute) {
        focusedRoute.eachLayer(layer => {
          if (layer.closePopup) layer.closePopup();
        });
        focusedRoute.remove();
        focusedRoute = null;
      }
    }

    function syncTourControls() {
      document.querySelectorAll('input[name="cb-policy"]').forEach(input => {
        input.checked = input.value === S.policy;
      });

      $('cb-state-choice').value = S.snapshot;
      $('cb-map-metric').value = S.metric;
      $('cb-show-zips').checked = S.showZips;
      $('cb-show-transfers').checked = S.showTransfers;
      $('cb-time-choice').value = S.time;

      drawZipPicker();

      // Existing listeners update the map, KPIs and hourly slider together.
      $('cb-time-choice').dispatchEvent(
        new Event('change', {bubbles: true})
      );
    }

    function focusTourTransfer(tr, scrollToMap = false) {
      if (!map || !tr || !validTourTransfer(tr)) return false;

      S.policy = tr.policy_key;
      S.time = tr.time_key;
      S.showTransfers = true;

      for (const zip of [tr.from_zip, tr.to_zip]) {
        if (zip != null && zips.includes(String(zip))) {
          S.zips.add(String(zip));
        }
      }

      syncTourControls();
      clearTourRoute();

      if (!map.getPane('cb-route-inspection')) {
        map.createPane('cb-route-inspection').style.zIndex = '625';
      }

      if (!focusRenderer) {
        focusRenderer = L.svg({pane: 'cb-route-inspection'});
      }

      focusedRoute = L.featureGroup().addTo(map);

      const a = [Number(tr.from_lat), Number(tr.from_lon)];
      const b = [Number(tr.to_lat), Number(tr.to_lon)];
      const origin = tr.from_station || tr.from_short_name;
      const destination = tr.to_station || tr.to_short_name;
      const interval =
        times.find(t => t.time_key === tr.time_key)?.time_label ||
        tr.time_label;

      const style = {
        renderer: focusRenderer,
        pane: 'cb-route-inspection'
      };

      // White outline keeps the highlighted route visible on the basemap.
      L.polyline([a, b], {
        ...style,
        color: '#fff',
        weight: 10,
        opacity: 1,
        interactive: false
      }).addTo(focusedRoute);

      const line = L.polyline([a, b], {
        ...style,
        color: '#087eaa',
        weight: 6,
        opacity: 1
      })
        .bindPopup(
          `<b>${safe(origin)} → ${safe(destination)}</b><br>` +
          `${fmt(tr.bikes)} ${num(tr.bikes) === 1 ? 'bike' : 'bikes'} relocated · ` +
          `${dec(tr.distance_km, 2)} km (straight-line)<br>` +
          `${safe(interval)}<br>` +
          '<small>Modeled operator relocation—not a customer trip or a truck road route.</small>',
          {
            maxWidth: 310,
            autoPan: false
          }
        )
        .addTo(focusedRoute);

      L.circleMarker(a, {
        ...style,
        radius: 9,
        color: '#fff',
        weight: 2,
        fillColor: '#1d4ed8',
        fillOpacity: 1
      })
        .bindTooltip('A · FROM', {
          permanent: true,
          direction: 'left'
        })
        .bindPopup(`<b>FROM: ${safe(origin)}</b>`)
        .addTo(focusedRoute);

      L.circleMarker(b, {
        ...style,
        radius: 9,
        color: '#fff',
        weight: 2,
        fillColor: '#047857',
        fillOpacity: 1
      })
        .bindTooltip('B · TO', {
          permanent: true,
          direction: 'right'
        })
        .bindPopup(`<b>TO: ${safe(destination)}</b>`)
        .addTo(focusedRoute);

      map.invalidateSize({
        animate: false,
        pan: false
      });

      map.fitBounds(L.latLngBounds(a, b).pad(0.5), {
        maxZoom: 16,
        padding: [45, 65],
        animate: false
      });

      line.openPopup();

      if (scrollToMap) {
        $('cb-map').scrollIntoView({
          behavior: 'smooth',
          block: 'center'
        });
      }

      return true;
    }

    // Keep the original drawing logic; remove stale highlights after filtering.
    const originalDrawMap = drawMap;

    drawMap = function () {
      clearTourRoute();
      originalDrawMap();
    };

    // Turn the existing transfer names into accessible map-location buttons.
    const originalDrawTransferTable = drawTransferTable;

    drawTransferTable = function () {
      originalDrawTransferTable();

      const routes = routeRows()
        .sort((a, b) =>
          num(b.bikes) - num(a.bikes) ||
          num(b.bike_km) - num(a.bike_km)
        )
        .slice(0, 9);

      const table = $('cb-transfer-table');
      const heading = table.querySelector('th');

      if (heading) {
        heading.textContent = 'From → To · click to locate';
      }

      table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach((row, i) => {
        const tr = routes[i];
        if (!tr) return;

        const cell = row.cells[0];
        const button = document.createElement('button');

        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'cb-route-link';
        button.title = 'Show this modeled transfer on the map';
        button.disabled = !map || !validTourTransfer(tr);

        while (cell.firstChild) {
          button.append(cell.firstChild);
        }

        cell.append(button);

        const time = document.createElement('small');
        time.className = 'cb-route-time';
        time.textContent =
          times.find(t => t.time_key === tr.time_key)?.time_label ||
          tr.time_label;

        cell.append(time);

        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          focusTourTransfer(tr, true);
        });
      });
    };

    tourApp.addEventListener('cb-tour-show-transfer', () => {
      if (savedTourView) return;

      let candidates = routeRows('lp', S.time).filter(validTourTransfer);

      if (!candidates.length) {
        candidates = (D.transfers || []).filter(tr =>
          tr.policy_key === 'lp' && validTourTransfer(tr)
        );
      }

      const tr = candidates
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) =>
          num(b.bikes) - num(a.bikes) ||
          num(a.distance_km) - num(b.distance_km)
        )[0];

      let detail = null;

      if (map && tr) {
        savedTourView = {
          state: {...S, zips: new Set(S.zips)},
          query: $('cb-zip-search').value,
          slider: $('cb-hour-range')?.value,
          center: map.getCenter(),
          zoom: map.getZoom()
        };

        if (focusTourTransfer(tr)) {
          detail = {
            from: tr.from_station || tr.from_short_name,
            to: tr.to_station || tr.to_short_name,
            bikes: fmt(tr.bikes),
            distance: dec(tr.distance_km, 2),
            time:
              times.find(t => t.time_key === tr.time_key)?.time_label ||
              tr.time_label
          };
        }
      }

      tourApp.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('cb-tour-example-ready', {detail})
      );
    });

    tourApp.addEventListener('cb-tour-clear-transfer', () => {
      if (!savedTourView) return;

      const saved = savedTourView;
      savedTourView = null;

      clearTourRoute();

      Object.assign(S, saved.state, {
        zips: new Set(saved.state.zips)
      });

      $('cb-zip-search').value = saved.query;

      // Restore the remembered slider position when returning to full-day mode.
      if (
        saved.state.time === 'all' &&
        saved.slider != null &&
        times[Number(saved.slider)]
      ) {
        S.time = times[Number(saved.slider)].time_key;
        syncTourControls();
        S.time = 'all';
      }

      syncTourControls();

      map.setView(saved.center, saved.zoom, {
        animate: false
      });
    });

    countUpdate();wireControls();drawZipPicker();initMap();drawBudget();updateAll();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start);else start();
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<style>
#cb-app .cb-top {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  text-align: center;
  margin: 14px 0 22px;
}
#cb-app .cb-heading-main { width: 100%; }
#cb-app .cb-title { text-align: center; }
#cb-app .cb-instructions {
  max-width: 850px;
  margin: 14px auto 0 !important;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}
#cb-app .cb-top-right { text-align: center; white-space: normal; }
#cb-app .cb-hour-nav { margin-top: 9px; }
#cb-app .cb-hour-heading {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px;
}
#cb-app .cb-hour-heading output { font-weight: 750; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; }
#cb-app .cb-hour-nav button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
#cb-app #cb-hour-range { width: 100%; margin: 13px 0 2px; accent-color: var(--cb-blue); cursor: pointer; }
#cb-app .cb-hour-ticks { position: relative; height: 14px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--cb-sub); }
#cb-app .cb-hour-ticks span { position: absolute; white-space: nowrap; }
#cb-app .cb-hour-bottom { margin-top: 10px; }
#cb-app .cb-hour-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--cb-sub); line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 8px; }
#cb-app .cb-full-day-chart .cb-trend { min-width: 1200px; gap: 5px; }
#cb-app .cb-full-day-chart .cb-time-group { min-width: 43px; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; }
#cb-app .cb-full-day-chart .cb-time-label { font-size: 10px; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  function initTimeNavigation() {
    const app = document.getElementById('cb-app');
    const select = document.getElementById('cb-time-choice');
    const dataNode = document.getElementById('cb-dashboard-json');
    if (!app || !select || !dataNode || document.getElementById('cb-hour-range')) return;
    let data;
    try { data = JSON.parse(dataNode.textContent); } catch (error) { console.error(error); return; }
    const times = (data.times || []).slice().sort((a, b) => a.time_key.localeCompare(b.time_key));
    if (!times.length || !select.options.length) return;
    const fullDay = times.length === 24;
    const label = t => t.time_key.slice(11, 16) === '23:00' && fullDay ? '23:00–24:00' : t.time_label;
    const summaryOption = [...select.options].find(o => o.value === 'all');
    if (summaryOption && fullDay) summaryOption.textContent = 'Full day (00:00–24:00)';
    for (const option of select.options) {
      const time = times.find(t => t.time_key === option.value);
      if (time) option.textContent = label(time);
    }
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'cb-hour-nav';
    panel.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cb-hour-heading">
        <button class="cb-button" type="button" id="cb-hour-prev" title="Previous hour" aria-label="Previous hour">&#8592;</button>
        <output id="cb-hour-label" for="cb-hour-range" aria-live="polite"></output>
        <button class="cb-button" type="button" id="cb-hour-next" title="Next hour" aria-label="Next hour">&#8594;</button>
      </div>
      <input id="cb-hour-range" type="range" min="0" max="${times.length - 1}" step="1" value="0" aria-label="Select a modeled hour">
      <div id="cb-hour-ticks" class="cb-hour-ticks"></div>
      <div class="cb-hour-bottom"><button class="cb-button" type="button" id="cb-hour-all">${fullDay ? 'View full day' : 'View all intervals'}</button></div>
      <div class="cb-hour-hint" id="cb-hour-hint"></div>`;
    select.after(panel);
    const range = document.getElementById('cb-hour-range');
    const output = document.getElementById('cb-hour-label');
    const prev = document.getElementById('cb-hour-prev');
    const next = document.getElementById('cb-hour-next');
    const all = document.getElementById('cb-hour-all');
    const hint = document.getElementById('cb-hour-hint');
    const chart = document.getElementById('cb-time-chart');
    const preferred = Math.max(0, times.findIndex(t => t.time_key.slice(11, 13) === '16'));
    let lastHour = preferred;
    const currentIndex = () => times.findIndex(t => t.time_key === select.value);
    const tickIndexes = fullDay ? [0, 6, 12, 18, 23] : [...new Set([0, Math.round((times.length - 1) / 4),
      Math.round((times.length - 1) / 2), Math.round(3 * (times.length - 1) / 4), times.length - 1])];
    document.getElementById('cb-hour-ticks').textContent = '';
    for (const i of tickIndexes) {
      const tick = document.createElement('span'); tick.textContent = times[i].time_key.slice(11, 16);
      tick.style.left = `${100 * i / Math.max(1, times.length - 1)}%`;
      tick.style.transform = i === 0 ? 'none' : i === times.length - 1 ? 'translateX(-100%)' : 'translateX(-50%)';
      document.getElementById('cb-hour-ticks').append(tick);
    }
    function sync() {
      const i = currentIndex(); const summary = i < 0;
      if (!summary) lastHour = i;
      range.value = String(lastHour);
      range.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', label(times[lastHour]));
      output.textContent = summary ? (fullDay ? '00:00–24:00 · totals' : 'All intervals') : label(times[i]);
      prev.disabled = !summary && i === 0;
      next.disabled = !summary && i === times.length - 1;
      all.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(summary));
      hint.textContent = summary
        ? 'Events are summed; inventory is the mean across intervals. Move the slider to inspect one hour.'
        : 'Drag the slider or use the arrows to move one hour at a time.';
      const meta = document.getElementById('cb-header-sub');
      if (meta) meta.textContent = `${times[0].time_key.slice(0, 10)} · ${times.length} modeled hourly intervals`;
      if (chart && fullDay) {
        chart.classList.add('cb-full-day-chart');
        chart.querySelectorAll('[data-time]').forEach(group => {
          const text = group.querySelector('.cb-time-label');
          if (text) text.textContent = group.dataset.time.slice(11, 16);
        });
      }
    }
    function choose(index) {
      index = Math.max(0, Math.min(times.length - 1, index));
      select.value = times[index].time_key;
      select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));
      sync();
    }
    range.addEventListener('input', () => choose(Number(range.value)));
    prev.addEventListener('click', () => choose(currentIndex() < 0 ? times.length - 1 : currentIndex() - 1));
    next.addEventListener('click', () => choose(currentIndex() < 0 ? 0 : currentIndex() + 1));
    all.addEventListener('click', () => { select.value = 'all'; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); sync(); });
    app.addEventListener('change', sync);
    app.addEventListener('click', sync);
    document.getElementById('cb-reset')?.addEventListener('click', () => choose(preferred));
    choose(preferred);
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initTimeNavigation);
  else initTimeNavigation();
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
    <div class="cb-tour-actions">
      <button id="cb-tour-back" type="button">Previous</button>
      <button id="cb-tour-next" type="button">Next →</button>
    </div>

    <button id="cb-tour-skip" type="button">
      Skip tour — explore on my own
    </button>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function initGuidedTour() {
    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

    const app = $('cb-app');
    const root = $('cb-tour-ui');
    const card = $('cb-tour-card');
    const spot = $('cb-tour-spot');

    if (!app || !root || !card || $('cb-tour-launch')) return;

    // Attach the overlay outside Quarto's content layout.
    document.body.append(root);

    const group = id => $(id)?.closest('.cb-group');
    const section = id => $(id)?.closest('.cb-detail-panel');

    const steps = [
      {
        title: 'Welcome to the scenario explorer',
        target: () => null,
        copy:
          'Explore how rebalancing changes bike availability and service outcomes ' +
          'over a modeled day. This tour explains the controls and how to read ' +
          'station-to-station transfers. These are simulations, not live operations.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Compare three policies',
        target: () => group('cb-policy-choice'),
        copy:
          'No rebalancing leaves bikes where customer trips take them. ' +
          'Reactive heuristic follows inventory rules. LP optimization plans ' +
          'transfers using the full day’s known scenario demand, service penalties ' +
          'and relocation costs.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Choose an hour',
        target: () => group('cb-time-choice'),
        copy:
          'Use the dropdown, slider or arrows to move through the day. ' +
          'View full day sums service events across hours; inventory is displayed ' +
          'as an hourly mean, not a daily total.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Focus on ZIP areas',
        target: () => group('cb-zip-search'),
        copy:
          'Tick ZIP codes, search for a code, or click a ZIP outline on the map. ' +
          'All restores the full geographic selection. A transfer is included ' +
          'when either endpoint lies in the selected area.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Read station dots',
        target: () => $('cb-map'),
        copy:
          'Click a station dot to see capacity, inventory and service results. ' +
          'Inventory Snapshot selects before rebalancing, after rebalancing or ' +
          'the end of the hour. Map Color switches between inventory fill and ' +
          'failure counts.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Understand bike transfers',
        transfer: true,
        target: () => $('cb-map'),
        copy:
          'The example highlights an existing LP transfer: A / FROM is the origin ' +
          'and B / TO is the destination. The popup reports bikes moved, ' +
          'straight-line distance and time. These lines represent modeled ' +
          'physical relocation—not customer rides or actual truck routes.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Check performance',
        target: () => app.querySelector('.cb-kpi-grid'),
        copy:
          'The cards show requested station events, service success, unmet ' +
          'departures, blocked arrivals and relocation effort. Bike-km means ' +
          'bikes moved multiplied by distance; it is not truck driving distance. ' +
          'Values follow the selected policy, hour and ZIP areas.'
      },
      {
        title: 'Inspect the detailed results',
        target: () => section('cb-transfer-table'),
        copy:
          'Click a station pair in Major Relocation Corridors to zoom to that ' +
          'transfer and its hour. Nearby panels compare policies, hours and ' +
          'station pressure. Budget Sensitivity shows separate precomputed ' +
          'scenarios; it does not change the map.'
      }
    ];

    // Add a permanent replay button below the centered heading.
    const launchRow = document.createElement('div');
    launchRow.className = 'cb-tour-launch-row';

    const launch = document.createElement('button');
    launch.id = 'cb-tour-launch';
    launch.type = 'button';
    launch.className = 'cb-button cb-tour-launch';
    launch.textContent = 'Quick tour';

    launchRow.append(launch);
    app.querySelector('.cb-top').append(launchRow);

    // A small contents menu lets readers jump directly to any step.
    steps.forEach((step, i) => {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = String(i);
      option.textContent = `${i + 1}. ${step.title}`;
      $('cb-tour-jump').append(option);
    });

    const masks = Object.fromEntries(
      [...root.querySelectorAll('[data-mask]')].map(node => [
        node.dataset.mask,
        node
      ])
    );

    const storageKey = 'capital-bikeshare-guided-tour-v2';

    let active = false;
    let index = 0;
    let previousFocus = null;
    let frame = null;

    const clamp = (value, low, high) =>
      Math.max(low, Math.min(high, value));

    function rect(node, x, y, width, height) {
      Object.assign(node.style, {
        left: `${x}px`,
        top: `${y}px`,
        width: `${Math.max(0, width)}px`,
        height: `${Math.max(0, height)}px`
      });
    }

    function seen() {
      try {
        return localStorage.getItem(storageKey) === '1';
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    function position() {
      if (!active) return;

      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;
      const w = card.offsetWidth;
      const h = card.offsetHeight;
      const target = steps[index].target();

      rect(masks.top, 0, 0, width, height);

      for (const key of ['left', 'right', 'bottom']) {
        rect(masks[key], 0, 0, 0, 0);
      }

      spot.hidden = true;

      let x = (width - w) / 2;
      let y = (height - h) / 2;

      if (target) {
        const b = target.getBoundingClientRect();

        const r = {
          left: clamp(b.left - 6, 4, width - 4),
          right: clamp(b.right + 6, 4, width - 4),
          top: clamp(b.top - 6, 4, height - 4),
          bottom: clamp(b.bottom + 6, 4, height - 4)
        };

        if (r.right > r.left + 2 && r.bottom > r.top + 2) {
          spot.hidden = false;

          rect(
            spot,
            r.left,
            r.top,
            r.right - r.left,
            r.bottom - r.top
          );

          rect(masks.top, 0, 0, width, r.top);
          rect(masks.left, 0, r.top, r.left, r.bottom - r.top);
          rect(
            masks.right,
            r.right,
            r.top,
            width - r.right,
            r.bottom - r.top
          );
          rect(masks.bottom, 0, r.bottom, width, height - r.bottom);

          if (width - r.right > w + 28) {
            x = r.right + 14;
            y = r.top;
          } else if (r.left > w + 28) {
            x = r.left - w - 14;
            y = r.top;
          } else if (height - r.bottom > h + 28) {
            x = r.left;
            y = r.bottom + 14;
          } else if (r.top > h + 28) {
            x = r.left;
            y = r.top - h - 14;
          } else {
            x = width - w - 12;
            y = height - h - 12;
          }
        }
      }

      card.style.left = `${clamp(x, 12, width - w - 12)}px`;
      card.style.top = `${clamp(y, 12, height - h - 12)}px`;
    }

    function positionSoon() {
      if (!active || frame !== null) return;

      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        frame = null;
        position();
      });
    }

    function show(nextIndex) {
      // Leaving the transfer demonstration restores the previous selection.
      if (steps[index].transfer) {
        app.dispatchEvent(new Event('cb-tour-clear-transfer'));
      }

      index = clamp(nextIndex, 0, steps.length - 1);
      const step = steps[index];

      $('cb-tour-count').textContent = `${index + 1} / ${steps.length}`;
      $('cb-tour-title').textContent = step.title;
      $('cb-tour-copy').textContent = step.copy;
      $('cb-tour-jump').value = String(index);
      $('cb-tour-back').disabled = index === 0;

      $('cb-tour-next').textContent =
        index === steps.length - 1 ? 'Finish ✓' : 'Next →';

      $('cb-tour-note').hidden = true;
      $('cb-tour-note').textContent = '';

      const target = step.target();

      if (target) {
        target.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: 'instant',
          block: 'center'
        });
      }

      if (step.transfer) {
        app.dispatchEvent(new Event('cb-tour-show-transfer'));
      }

      position();
      $('cb-tour-next').focus({preventScroll: true});
      positionSoon();
    }

    function open() {
      if (active) return;

      previousFocus = document.activeElement;
      active = true;
      index = 0;
      root.hidden = false;

      show(0);
    }

    function close() {
      if (!active) return;

      if (steps[index].transfer) {
        app.dispatchEvent(new Event('cb-tour-clear-transfer'));
      }

      active = false;
      root.hidden = true;

      try {
        localStorage.setItem(storageKey, '1');
      } catch (_) {
        // Some browsers restrict storage when opening local HTML files.
      }

      const focus =
        previousFocus && previousFocus !== document.body
          ? previousFocus
          : launch;

      focus?.focus({preventScroll: true});
    }

    launch.addEventListener('click', open);

    // Choosing a real route exits the tour so the map is unobstructed.
    app.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (active && event.target.closest('.cb-route-link')) {
        close();
      }
    });

    $('cb-tour-close').addEventListener('click', close);
    $('cb-tour-skip').addEventListener('click', close);

    $('cb-tour-back').addEventListener('click', () => {
      show(index - 1);
    });

    $('cb-tour-next').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (index === steps.length - 1) {
        close();
      } else {
        show(index + 1);
      }
    });

    $('cb-tour-jump').addEventListener('change', event => {
      show(Number(event.target.value));
    });

    app.addEventListener('cb-tour-example-ready', event => {
      if (!active || !steps[index].transfer) return;

      const d = event.detail;

      $('cb-tour-note').textContent = d
        ? `Saved example: ${d.from} → ${d.to}. ` +
          `${d.bikes} bike(s), ${d.distance} km, ${d.time}. ` +
          'The tour temporarily selects this LP hour; leaving this step ' +
          'restores your previous filters and map view.'
        : 'No positive LP transfer is available, or the map has not loaded. ' +
          'No example data have been invented.';

      $('cb-tour-note').hidden = false;
      positionSoon();
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', positionSoon, {
      passive: true
    });

    window.addEventListener('scroll', positionSoon, {
      passive: true,
      capture: true
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (!active) return;

      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        close();
        return;
      }

      // Do not steal arrow keys from the map, slider or dropdowns.
      if (
        !card.contains(event.target) ||
        ['INPUT', 'SELECT'].includes(event.target.tagName)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (index === steps.length - 1) {
          close();
        } else {
          show(index + 1);
        }
      } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        event.preventDefault();
        show(index - 1);
      }
    });

    // Show automatically on the first visit; the replay button remains available.
    if (
      !seen() ||
      new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tour') === '1'
    ) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(open));
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initGuidedTour);
  } else {
    initGuidedTour();
  }
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<style id="cb-tour-light-theme">
/* Hide the step selector without breaking existing JavaScript references. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-jump {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Dim the page behind the tour. */
#cb-tour-ui .cb-tour-mask {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.42);
}

/* Highlight the control or panel being explained. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-spot {
  border-color: #0d9488;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95),
    0 0 0 6px rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.22);
}

/* Main introduction card. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #172337;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  box-shadow:
    0 20px 60px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22),
    0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10);
  color-scheme: light;
}

/* Step counter, heading and explanatory text. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-count {
  color: #0f766e;
}

#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-title {
  color: #172337;
}

#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-copy {
  color: #475569;
}

/* Highlighted transfer-example explanation. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-note {
  background: #f0fdfa;
  color: #115e59;
  border-left-color: #0d9488;
}

/* Close button. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-close {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #475569;
  border-color: #d5dee8;
}

#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-close:hover {
  background: #e2e8f0;
  color: #172337;
}

/* Previous button and shared navigation styling. */
#cb-tour-ui .cb-tour-actions button {
  background: #f8fafc;

  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}

#cb-tour-ui .cb-tour-actions button:not(:disabled):hover {
  background: #eaf0f5;
  border-color: #94a3b8;
}

/* Next / Finish button. */
#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-next {
  background: #0f766e;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: #0f766e;
}

#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-next:not(:disabled):hover {
  background: #115e59;

}

}

#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-skip {

}

#cb-tour-ui #cb-tour-skip:hover {

}

/* Keyboard focus indicator. */
#cb-tour-ui button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #0d9488;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Permanent Quick tour button below the dashboard heading. */
#cb-app .cb-tour-launch {
  background: #f0fdfa;
  color: #0f766e;
  border-color: #99d9d0;
}

#cb-app .cb-tour-launch:hover {
  background: #ccfbf1;
  border-color: #0d9488;
}

#cb-app .cb-tour-launch:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #0d9488;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
</style>
```
